name: Adjustable 3D Knee Support Band with Patella Gel Pad & Anti-Slip Grip
description:
Stay active and protected with the Adjustable 3D Knee Support Band. Designed with a pressure-weave ergonomic structure, it provides 360° compression, stability, and comfort for workouts, sports, or daily wear. The built-in patella gel pad protects the knee joint while the breathable, lightweight fabric ensures all-day comfort. Perfect for arthritis, ligament strains, or post-injury recovery.
Key Features
 3D ergonomic design for full knee support
 Anti-slip silicone grip with dual Velcro straps
 Patella gel pad for shock absorption
 Breathable, lightweight & quick-dry fabric
 Adjustable size fits thighs 14″–22″
 Suitable for sports, gym, running, hiking & daily use
Ingredients / Materials
Nylon, spandex, silicone gel grip, Velcro straps
How to Use
 Wrap the band around your knee
 Adjust straps with Velcro for firm compression
 Ensure gel pad is positioned over patella
 Wear during activity or recovery as needed
Package Includes
 1 × Adjustable 3D Knee Support Band
